text.tspan: Routing policies: how Route 53 chooses the answer (DNS answers, it does not route traffic)
one record, one or many values
add a Default record or get
not a substitute for an ELB
• Send 10% to the new version → Weighted · DR site only when primary fails → Failover · fastest Region → Latency
• Show French site / respect distribution rights by country → Geolocation · move more users to one Region → Geoproximity bias
• Users from a known ISP / IP range → IP-based · several healthy IPs, client-side → Multivalue · one server → Simple
• Weighted, failover, latency, geolocation, geoproximity, multivalue: records share the same name and type
